title: finding(app-shell,i18n): four designer inspectors still render about 115 hard-coded English strings (section titles, field labels, placeholders, hints) while their 15 siblings read `t()`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with named sites (class a): a non-English author sees an English form in four of the designer's inspectors. Reader: triage first (route and grade; it may want splitting per inspector), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10448 dev report (PR objectui#10551). The dev confirmed `HookDefaultInspector` at source and named "more English literals in two inspectors"; recorded on ACCEPT `5829506009`. The seat then measured the whole inspector directory. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Census (the seat's, on `origin/main` at `90dbd1d31`)

Over `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/*.tsx`, excluding tests, the seat counted literal-English attributes (`label|title|placeholder|hint="Capitalised …"`) and literal JSX text nodes (`>Capitalised words<`), and set that beside `t(` / `tr(` call counts. The regex is a floor: it misses lower-case and template strings.

| inspector | English literals | `t()` calls |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` | 49 | 15 |
| `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` | 38 | 1 |
| `HookDefaultInspector.tsx` | 19 | 7 |
| `FlowReferenceField.tsx` | 6 | 4 |
| `ConditionBuilder.tsx` | 2 | 1 |
| the other 15 (`ObjectFieldInspector` 111 `t()`, `ObjectDefaultInspector` 34, `AppNavInspector` 30, …) | 0 | — |

Examples: `HookDefaultInspector.tsx:~197–343` (`title="Basics"`, `label="Label"`, `placeholder="Human-readable name"`, "Object(s) this hook fires on", "Select at least one event.", "Run asynchronously (after commit)", …); `FlowReferenceField.tsx:~736` `placeholder="Resolved automatically"`; `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx:~617` `title="Basics"`.

This is the designer hard-coded-English family. objectui#9652 and objectui#10448 (both closed) fixed the unknown-value FLAGS; this card is the rest of the text in the inspectors that still lag.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Route the strings through the existing `engine.inspector.*` / `engine.form.*` namespaces, as the 15 translated siblings do, with keys in every built-in locale. Grading, and whether to split it per inspector, is triage's call. `ConditionBuilder`'s two are small enough to ride any of the others.
